name: TENGA EGG Series
summary: Pocket-sized ultra-stretchy egg sleeve offering inventive varied internal textures under $10—stretching smoothly to fit any size.
ranking_rationale: Ultra-budget ~$9 price fits effortlessly in carry-on luggage with zero weight (trade-off: designed primarily as single-to-few-use sleeves due to thin tear risk).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.

pros: Ultra-budget ~$9 price fits effortlessly in carry-on luggage with zero weight

cons: Designed primarily as single-to-few-use sleeves due to thin tear risk
